name: XWiki
description: XWiki is a free, open source wiki platform written in Java. It offers structured data, applications inside the wiki, a powerful extension system and fine-grained permissions, and is a common alternative to Confluence.

notes.text: On first start open http://<IP>:8080/xwiki/ and finish the Distribution Wizard: create the admin account and install the XWiki Standard flavor. This takes a few minutes.
The database (PostgreSQL by default, MariaDB optional) and its random password are created by the Debian package; the connection is stored in /etc/xwiki/hibernate.cfg.xml.
The Java heap is set to about 60 % of the container RAM in /etc/default/tomcat10. XWiki needs at least 2 GiB, 4 GiB is recommended.
Take a snapshot or backup before updating; major XWiki upgrades finish with the Distribution Wizard in the browser.
